snp1.11:2.4:
the body isn’t seen
for what it is:
snp1.11:3.1: filled with intestines, filled with stomach,
snp1.11:3.2:
with the lump of the liver,
bladder,
snp1.11:5.1:
On top of that,
in nine streams,
snp1.11:5.2: filth is always flowing from it—
snp1.11:6.2:
from the mouth it vomits :
now vomit,
snp1.11:6.4: from the body : beads of sweat.
snp1.11:7.1:
And on top of that,
its hollow head is filled with brains.
snp1.11:7.3:
The fool, beset by ignorance,
thinks it beautiful,
snp1.11:8.3: cast away in a charnel ground,
snp1.11:8.4: even relatives don’t care for it.
snp1.11:9.4: along with any other animals there.
snp1.11:10.1:
Having heard the Awakened One’s words,
the discerning monk
snp1.11:10.4:
for he sees it
for what it is:
snp1.11:11.3:
Within & without,
he should let desire for the body
fade away.
snp1.11:12.1:
With desire & passion faded away,
the discerning monk arrives here:
snp1.11:12.4:
the unfallen, undying state
of unbinding.
snp1.11:13.1:
This two-footed thing is cared for,
filthy,
snp1.11:14.1:
Whoever would think,
on the basis of a body like this,
snp1.11:14.2: to exalt himself or disparage another—
snp1.11:14.4:
What is that
if not blindness?
